description: This is an interface defining email-related services within the Fineract platform, specifying methods for sending emails to users and predefined email details.

classes.name: PlatformEmailService
classes.description: Interface for email services providing methods to send emails to users and defined email details.

methods.name: sendToUserAccount
methods.description: Sends an email to a user account with specified organization name, contact name, address, username, and password.

methods.name: sendDefinedEmail
methods.description: Sends an email based on the provided EmailDetail object, which encapsulates email content and metadata.
